preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges m must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= s <= n and 1 <= t <= n and s != t
preconditions.description: The start vertex s and end vertex t must be within the range of vertices and must be different.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices u and v must be within the range of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of paths modulo 10^9 + 7.
